plainTranslation: A's depth and power meets B's drive. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control press against your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The harder part is when it becomes a struggle that neither of you can put down. One person pushes, the other pushes back, and what starts as friction can build into something that feels less like conflict and more like a fight for control of the whole relationship. The reactive, buried parts of both of you surface, and they do not always stay in proportion. You may find yourselves locked together by the charge even as the connection turns corrosive, pulled back again and again into something that wears you down a little more each time, until you barely recognize how much it has cost you.
advice: Hold your ground without needing to win, and watch honestly what this is doing to you over months, not moments. This works only when the intensity builds rather than destroys. If you are always braced, always recovering from the last round, always pulled back just when you have gathered the strength to step away, that is not a connection finding its balance. That is a pattern, and you are allowed to leave it.
